ValidationRule.description: CC-5187 Customer Name is Read-Only for ANZ ML Standard User
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name = 'ANZ ML Standard User', OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PersonAccount', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Business_Account'), OR(ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Salutation), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(MiddleName), ISCHANGED(Suffix), ISCHANGED(Suffix__pc), ISCHANGED(PersonTitle)), OCV_Event_Version__c <> 0 )
